text: The 'BARCELOS' mark on the shirt is the Município de Barcelos (Câmara Municipal de Barcelos), the town council of Barcelos, sponsoring in its own name: the club's partners page lists Barcelos among its OFFICIAL SPONSORS with a link to cm-barcelos.pt, the official municipal website.
short: The Barcelos shirt mark is the town council itself.

source.name: Município de Barcelos (official website)
source.note: The site cm-barcelos.pt is the official website of the Município de Barcelos and carries the Câmara Municipal de Barcelos (town council) structure. The club's partners page (https://gilvicentefc.pt/patrocinadores/) links its BARCELOS logo to this address with the label OFFICIAL SPONSOR.

additionalSources.name: Gil Vicente FC: Parceiros - Juntos pelo Gil
additionalSources.quote: Marcas, instituições e empresas que caminham connosco dentro e fora de campo.
additionalSources.note: English: brands, institutions and companies that walk with us on and off the pitch. The page lists Barcelos (cm-barcelos.pt) as an OFFICIAL SPONSOR, and the club store's back photo of the 2026-27 home shirt shows 'BARCELOS' across the upper back.
